nodes.label: Extension Hooks Protocol
nodes.rationale: Reads .specify/extensions.yml; honors hooks.before_<cmd> and hooks.after_<cmd>. Filters out hooks where enabled=false; does not interpret hook condition expressions (deferred to HookExecutor). Mandatory hooks (optional:false) MUST be invoked; optional hooks surfaced with a prompt. No-silent-skip on parse errors.

nodes.label: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] Marker Convention
nodes.rationale: Hard cap of 3 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers per spec; prioritized by scope > security/privacy > UX > technical. Used as honest placeholder for guesses that have multiple reasonable interpretations with different implications.

nodes.label: Spec Quality Checklist (requirements.md)
nodes.rationale: Built-in reviewer-owned checklist at FEATURE_DIR/checklists/requirements.md maintained by /speckit.specify and /speckit.clarify. Distinct from custom checklists generated by /speckit.checklist. Marker state is read-only gate for /speckit.implement.

nodes.label: Spec Kit Template Resolution Stack
nodes.rationale: Project overrides compose with preset layers and extension layers above a core template fallback. Resolved at command time via .specify/scripts/powershell/resolve-template.ps1. Spec/plan/constitution/tasks templates resolved independently.

nodes.label: Handoff Metadata in YAML Frontmatter
nodes.rationale: Frontmatter 'handoffs:' list declares next-stage commands (label, agent, prompt, optional send:true). Used by /speckit.specify → speckit.plan/clarify, /speckit.plan → speckit.tasks/checklist, /speckit.tasks → speckit.analyze/implement.

hyperedges.label: Core Spec-Driven Development chain (specify → clarify → plan → tasks → implement)
